## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Contracts changed → `pnpm codegen`, generated files committed
- [ ] Classes changed → `pnpm docs:classes`, class diagram committed
- [ ] New library, layer, pattern or convention → new ADR and both ADR indexes updated
- [ ] New setting → `.env.example`, `.env.production.example` and `docs/operations/configuration.md`
- [ ] Comments only name design patterns (ADR-0035)
